post.caption: Harry Winston once made a bra. In 1997, Tyra Banks wore Victoria's Secret's Diamond Dream Bra, with a pear shaped diamond of 42 carats at its center. In 2000, Gisele Bündchen's ruby bra carried about 300 carats of Thai rubies and was priced at 15 million dollars. Guinness listed it as the most expensive lingerie. In 2001, Heidi Klum wore the first Fantasy Bra on the runway, with a 90 carat emerald cut diamond. In 2013, the Royal Fantasy Bra had a 52 carat ruby.
